name: Crispy Sweet Potato Waffle Fries Side
whyItWorks: Sweet potato fries contain high levels of insoluble fiber from the skin and cell walls, combined with significant oil absorption from deep-frying. Sweet potatoes also contain polyols that can produce gas in IBS/IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fiber & Grease Warning: Stick to a small handful if in remission. Avoid during active flare-ups.
